title: Battle of Havana (1748)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Havana (1748)", at revision 1370442712, opens: "The Battle of Havana was fought between 12–14 October 1748 off Havana between the British and Spanish navies during the War of Jenkins' Ear. A British squadron under Rear-Admiral of the Red Charles Knowles attacked a Spanish squadron led by Lieutenant-general Andrés Reggio during an attempt by Knowles to intercept the Spanish treasure fleet." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1136414, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1748 naval battle between British and Spanish squadrons in the War of Jenkins' Ear". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
